aboutText: I'm a Filmmaker, Cinematographer, and Video Editor with over three years of experience transforming ideas and raw footage into compelling visual stories.
My work spans films, YouTube content, social media, branded projects, AI-generated videos, and creative productions.
I combine cinematography, editing, sound design, color grading, and storytelling to create videos that are visually polished, emotionally engaging, and purposeful.

services.title: Film & Video Editing
services.description: Structural cutting, rhythm and performance — edits that build tension, land jokes and break hearts.

services.title: Cinematography
services.description: Light, framing and camera language crafted shot by shot until every frame pushes the story forward.

services.title: YouTube Video Editing
services.description: Retention-first pacing, hook-first opens, b-roll, sound design and clean motion graphics built for the algorithm.

services.title: Social Media Content
services.description: Vertical edits tuned for short attention spans — hooks in the first second, rhythm that stops the scroll.

services.title: Color Grading
services.description: Cinematic palettes and natural skin tones — from clean dailies to a single, finished look.

services.title: Sound Design
services.description: Ambience, foley and mix that make the image breathe and the room feel real.

services.title: AI Video Production
services.description: Concept to output with today's generative tools — blended with real footage so it never looks synthetic.

process.title: Discover
process.description: We talk story, goals and reference. I find the angle before a single frame is shot.

process.title: Create
process.description: Shooting or sourcing — raw material captured with intent, not left to chance.

process.title: Edit
process.description: From the assembly, to the firstcut, and to the finalcut, there's rhythm, structure and narrative assembled in the timeline.

process.title: Refine
process.description: Color, sound, graphics and polish — every frame pulled toward the story.

process.title: Deliver
process.description: Formats, masters and specs for every platform — shipped and ready to publish.
